connecting-screen.description: The bundled connecting and error screen may read the connection state, ask to reconnect and use the zoom shortcuts and read the saved theme. It has no remote URLs, so pages the daemon serves get no capability at all.

daemon-pages.description: The attached daemon pages may open the folder picker, manage the bundled CLI and agent plugins and set the window's zoom from Settings, show, check for and install app updates from Settings, save an exported tile type file where the person chooses, open and close the hidden tile check window, open links to other sites in the browser, use the zoom shortcuts, and report the saved colour theme. Other setup commands remain restricted to the bundled screen.

setup-screen.description: The bundled setup screen may read what is installed, install or remove the baum command, install, update or remove the user-wide agent hooks, sign in to GitHub through the daemon, register repositories and change review settings when the user asks, use the zoom shortcuts, read the saved theme, open links to other sites in the browser, and leave setup. It has no remote URLs, so pages the daemon serves cannot call these commands.

tile-check.description: The hidden tile check window loads the attached daemon's check page and may call no command: the page reports its results to the daemon over HTTP. The main window's daemon page opens and closes the window.

tray-panel.description: The bundled tray panel may read the tray's view, fit its window to its height and read the saved theme and run the panel's own actions (Open, pause, Quit and stop, a waiting session, close), in its own window only. It has no remote URLs.
